rationale: Event-shaped value channels carry occurrences rather than sampled state. One transferred surface moves with this capability: value_source.hpp gains ValueEvent, EventFrame, and EventSource. EventFrame uses a compile-time ceiling plus runtime count, preserving the fixed-size trivially-copyable TripleBuffer payload required for an allocation-free, non-blocking audio-thread publish path. Presence is structural: a zero-valued occurrence occupies a slot with its frame index, while no occurrence means count is zero, so authors never need a sentinel. The channel is latest-wins like the existing visualization sources and inherits PublishCounter so the UI crosses into JavaScript only for a newly published non-empty block. This is Pulp-specific plugin-UI capability work with no counterpart framework behavior to backport.
